# The Mountaineers

> The Mountaineers is a Pacific Northwest nonprofit organization dedicated to exploring, learning, and conserving the outdoors through activities, education, and environmental stewardship.

Founded as a 501(c)(3) nonprofit, The Mountaineers engages thousands of members and volunteers in hiking, climbing, paddling, and conservation work across the Pacific Northwest. The organization also operates Mountaineers Books, a publisher of outdoor recreation and environmental literature.

## Getting Started & Explore

- [The Mountaineers - Explore, Learn, Conserve - Get Outside](https://www.mountaineers.org): The Mountaineers homepage with latest news, outdoor activities, and community events.
- [ACTIVITIES *get outside with us* — The Mountaineers](https://www.mountaineers.org/activities): Main activities page for hiking, climbing, paddling, and outdoor adventures.
- [Find Activities — The Mountaineers](https://www.mountaineers.org/activities/activities): Activity search and listings with trip finder and notification preferences.
- [Activity Overviews — The Mountaineers](https://www.mountaineers.org/activities/activity-overviews): Guide to activity types, difficulty ratings, and participation prerequisites.

## Outdoor Education & Skill Development

- [COURSES *learn new ways to explore the outdoors* — The Mountaineers](https://www.mountaineers.org/activities/course-overviews): Outdoor courses and skill-development programs for safe outdoor exploration.
- [Find Courses, Clinics & More — The Mountaineers](https://www.mountaineers.org/activities/courses-clinics-seminars): Courses, clinics, and seminars directory taught by passionate volunteers.
- [Virtual Education Center — The Mountaineers](https://www.mountaineers.org/activities/virtual-education-center): Online learning resources and virtual outdoor education programs.

## Conservation & Environmental Stewardship

- [CONSERVATION *protect the outdoors* — The Mountaineers](https://www.mountaineers.org/conservation): Conservation initiatives protecting public lands and outdoor experiences.
- [Stewardship — The Mountaineers](https://www.mountaineers.org/conservation/stewardship): Volunteer-led stewardship activities for land and water conservation.
- [Advocacy — The Mountaineers](https://www.mountaineers.org/conservation/advocacy): Environmental advocacy efforts to protect public lands and outdoor access.
- [Conservation Education — The Mountaineers](https://www.mountaineers.org/conservation/education): Education on protecting public lands and environmental stewardship.

## Volunteer Opportunities & Community Engagement

- [VOLUNTEER *and make a difference* — The Mountaineers](https://www.mountaineers.org/volunteer): Volunteer opportunities for teaching, leading trips, and community engagement.
- [Volunteer With Us — The Mountaineers](https://www.mountaineers.org/volunteer/volunteer-with-us): Volunteer opportunities in teaching, trips, events, and stewardship.
- [Find Volunteer Activities — The Mountaineers](https://www.mountaineers.org/volunteer/find-volunteer-activities): Search and find volunteer activity opportunities with The Mountaineers.
- [Volunteer Support Tools — The Mountaineers](https://www.mountaineers.org/volunteer/volunteer-support-tools): Guide for volunteers on website navigation, standards, and policies.
- [Scheduling & Managing Courses, Activities, Events and More — The Mountaineers](https://www.mountaineers.org/volunteer/schedule-manage): How-to guide for scheduling and managing courses, activities, and events.
